The OpenAPI Initiative's JSON Schemas for OpenAPI documents, which the export tests validate every
document against: `schema-3.1.json` is https://spec.openapis.org/oas/3.1/schema/2025-11-23 and
`schema-3.2.json` is https://spec.openapis.org/oas/3.2/schema/2025-11-23, unchanged. They are
